skill.name: onboarding-cro
skill.description: Design and optimize product onboarding flows that shorten time to value, improve activation, and support long-term retention.
skill.summary: Create focused onboarding journeys, activation metrics, lifecycle messages, and experiments for digital products.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: New users often abandon products before reaching meaningful value. This skill designs focused onboarding flows, activation metrics, experiments, and re-engagement tactics that improve retention.
actual_capabilities: Defines activation events and supporting metrics for digital products.
Audits onboarding flows for friction, unclear actions, and drop-off risks.
Designs step-by-step onboarding journeys, checklists, empty states, and guided experiences.
Creates onboarding microcopy, lifecycle email plans, and milestone messages.
Proposes measurable experiments for sequencing, personalization, engagement, and reactivation.
limitations: Requires product context, user behavior, and funnel data for specific recommendations.
Does not access analytics systems or validate conclusions against live data.
Does not implement product interfaces, tracking events, or messaging automation.
Recommendations require testing for each audience, product, and regulatory environment.

use_cases.title: Audit a SaaS Onboarding Funnel
use_cases.description: Identify friction after signup and prioritize changes that move users toward the activation event.

use_cases.title: Design a Mobile First-Session Flow
use_cases.description: Sequence permissions, quick wins, progress cues, and re-engagement messages for new mobile users.

use_cases.title: Plan Activation Experiments
use_cases.description: Turn funnel drop-offs and cohort evidence into testable onboarding hypotheses with clear success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Define the Activation Event
prompt_templates.prompt: Define a practical activation event for [product]. The core value is [value], and retained users usually [behavior].
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a clear measure of first value.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Current Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this onboarding flow: [steps]. Identify friction, estimate impact, and recommend prioritized improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate an existing journey with known steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Complete Journey
prompt_templates.prompt: Design onboarding for [audience] using [product]. Include the activation goal, screens, checklist, empty states, emails, and measurement plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a coordinated product and lifecycle experience.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Experiment Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these funnel and cohort results, create an onboarding experiment portfolio: [data]. Rank hypotheses by evidence, impact, effort, risk, and learning value.
prompt_templates.scenario: Develop an advanced evidence-based optimization program.

output_examples.input: Audit a project management onboarding flow that requires workspace setup before users can create a project.
output: Finding: Workspace setup delays the first meaningful task.
Impact: Users cannot experience project creation quickly.
Recommendation: Create the first project before optional workspace configuration.

output_examples.input: Create a short onboarding checklist for a self-service analytics product.
output: Invite a teammate to review insights.

output_examples.input: Suggest metrics for testing a personalized onboarding path.
output: Primary metric: Percentage of new users reaching the activation event.
Secondary metric: Median time from signup to activation.
Guardrail: First-week support requests and early churn.
Segment results by role, acquisition source, and selected goal.

best_practices: Provide the product value proposition, target audience, current flow, activation rate, and known drop-off points.
Define one observable activation event before designing screens or messages.
Test recommendations with controlled experiments and review results by user segment.
anti_patterns: Do not teach every feature during the first session.
Do not add mandatory setup steps that delay the first useful outcome.
Do not optimize completion rates without checking activation and retention.

faq.question: What products can this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports SaaS products, marketplaces, mobile applications, collaboration tools, and content platforms.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, value proposition, current onboarding steps, activation definition, funnel metrics, and known user problems.

faq.question: Can it define an activation metric?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose an observable event based on early behaviors that correlate with retained usage.

faq.question: Can it write onboarding copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft welcome screens, checklist text, empty states, tooltips, emails, and milestone messages.

faq.question: Does it implement analytics or product changes?
faq.answer: No. It provides designs, copy, measurement plans, and experiments for teams to implement and validate.

faq.question: How should recommendations be validated?
faq.answer: Use instrumented experiments, compare relevant cohorts, monitor guardrail metrics, and review qualitative feedback.
